East Africa's coach network since 2007

Cross four countries.
One ticket.

Modern Coast Express links Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania and Rwanda by road — Nairobi, Mombasa, Kampala, Kisumu, Kigali, Dar es Salaam and beyond, on scheduled coaches with three classes of seating.

The network

Seven hubs, four countries, one road network.

The core corridor runs from the Kenyan coast inland to the Great Lakes — with a second line reaching south into Tanzania.

Regional hub — Nairobi Terminus / stop Coastal & northern corridor

Three classes, one coach

Choose your seat, not just your ticket.

Every coach carries all three classes side by side, so the fare scales to the trip rather than the bus.

Entry

Business Class

Standard reclining seats with the full network of routes and departure times available to book against.

Seat typeReclining, shared armrest
LegroomStandard
Best forShort & mid-distance hops
Mid-tier

First Class

Wider double seats with extra recline, positioned toward the front of the cabin.

Seat typeWide double seat
LegroomExtended
Best forOvernight cross-border runs
Most booked
Premium

VIP

Single leather recliners with the most legroom on board — limited to a handful of seats per coach.

Seat typeSingle leather recliner
LegroomMaximum
Best forLong-haul comfort

Onboard

What's the same in every seat.

Onboard WiFi

Free wireless internet for the length of the trip, coast to border.

Charging ports

A power outlet at every seat, so devices last the whole route.

Scheduled departures

Fixed times across the day and overnight, not a fill-and-go van.

In-house maintenance

Coaches are serviced at company workshops between border runs.
